Storm leaves thousands without power

By A Reporter, BBC News

Thousands of homes were left without power after a storm brought winds of up to 90mph to the west coast overnight, the power network said.

Engineers worked through the morning to restore supplies, with the worst affected areas expected to be reconnected by the evening. Ferry services were suspended and several schools closed.

The forecaster warned of further disruption on Tuesday, with a second band of rain expected to move in from the Atlantic.
